title: Ungulate vocalizations and production context

equation_quality.supported_scope: See exact linked equations and parameter states; successful replay is not mechanism identification.

independent_units.independent_unit_description: Animal within species; all calls and typo-linked names grouped

calibration_burden: No held-animal labeled calibration. Fixed waveform summaries; any coefficients, centers or species normalization fitted only on training animals.

baseline_strength.scope: Matched task/input access; historical controls are not claimed to exhaust state of the art.

practical_relevance.prediction_time: After the complete author-extracted call. Predictors only waveform summaries and known species. File context words, animal ID, call label and source reference are never predictors.
practical_relevance.claim_blockers: Labels describe recording context; recording conditions and species can confound acoustic interpretation.

promotion_conditions: Reassess only under a versioned contract; never rename exposed outcomes as fresh.

practical_use_contract.decision_or_analysis: Estimate Source positive-context label probability under the exact registered input budget
practical_use_contract.intended_user: Domain researcher or process analyst; operational adoption not demonstrated

practical_use_contract.calibration_requirement: No held-animal labeled calibration. Fixed waveform summaries; any coefficients, centers or species normalization fitted only on training animals.
practical_use_contract.calibration_cost: Not monetized or timed in the corpus; no zero-cost assumption
practical_use_contract.actionable_output: Source positive-context label probability in probability
practical_use_contract.failure_boundary: Labels describe recording context; recording conditions and species can confound acoustic interpretation.
